ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; visible surface area is approximately 95% dark-spectrum (black/dark grey) with 5% high-intensity (white) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly dark-pixel background across both lobes. High-contrast white linear streaks are concentrated on the upper right lobe. High-intensity white banding and irregular mottling are present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse circular white spots are distributed across the lower central region near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel-calculated angle is approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary. Left lobe features small-scale, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe displays larger, lower-frequency peaks and valleys, including a prominent deep notch/indentation approximately 2/3 of the way toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the medial notch to the lateral tips; trailing edge geometry follows an outward-bowed trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (approx. 2-10 pixels in diameter) are visible in the lower-central region and mid-section of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5-6 parallel vertical white linear marks (rake marks) on the upper mid-section of the right lobe; isolated diagonal white streaks visible on the central left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip; extensive high-contrast white scarring and callous-like tissue observed at both lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of high-contrast white linear 'scratch' patterns and circular focal points clustered exclusively at the extreme distal ends of the flukes.
